content: Codex 0.147.0 official app-server stable protocol requires initialize then initialized and supports stdio JSONL. account/rateLimits/read returns rateLimits, optional rateLimitsByLimitId, and reset credits; snapshots contain primary/secondary windows, usedPercent, duration, resetsAt, plan/credit/spend fields. It is for ChatGPT-backed auth. Generated schema is version-specific and must be used.
